授权码。

> 在[号码百科控制台](https://dytns.console.aliyun.com/analysis/apply)**我的申请**页面，获取授权ID即授权码。
description.en:
The authorization code.

> On the **My Applications** page of the [Cell Phone Number Service console](https://dytns.console.aliyun.com/analysis/apply), obtain the authorization ID, which is the authorization code.

description.zh:
待查询的号码。

> 目前仅支持单个号码查询。
description.en:
The phone number to be queried.

> Currently, only single phone number queries are supported.

description.zh:
号码的加密方式。取值：**NORMAL**。


><notice>目前仅支持NORMAL加密方式。></notice>
description.en:
The encryption method of the phone number. Valid value: **NORMAL**.


><notice>Currently, only the NORMAL encryption method is supported.></notice>

description.zh: 用户自定的outId，选填，格式不限，长度小于等于64。
description.en: The user-defined outId. This parameter is optional. The format is not limited, and the length must be less than or equal to 64 characters.

descriptions.zh:
使用本接口前，请登录号码百科控制台，在[标签广场](https://dytns.console.aliyun.com/analysis/square)页面，找到对应的标签，单击**申请开通**，填写申请资料，审批通过后即可使用。

### QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为1000次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
Before you use this API, log on to the Cell Phone Number Service console, go to the [Tag Plaza](https://dytns.console.aliyun.com/analysis/square) page, find the corresponding tag, click **Apply for Activation**, and fill in the application materials. You can use this API after the application is approved.

### QPS limit
The per-user QPS limit of this API is 1,000 calls per second. If the number of API calls exceeds the limit, the calls will be throttled, which may affect your business. Call the API properly.
